name: OpenSearch (your instance)
description: Searches YOUR OWN OpenSearch cluster instance for an indicator (IP, domain, URL or file hash). Read-only. The server is not part of Mayfair; you supply its address and key.

installRequirements.name: Instance address and key saved in Ghost

externalRestrictions: Contacts only the address you saved in your instance config; nothing is bundled and nothing is sent to Mayfair. Your key is kept in <userData>/ghost/instances/ with owner-only permissions and never appears in logs, job history or results. Email addresses, phone numbers and account handles are refused as search values. Shown as installed only after the instance answers the self-test. Searches only the index pattern named in your config. Elasticsearch is refused.
